```sql
WITH tenant_customers AS (
    SELECT c.id,
           c.email,
           c.company,
           c.country_code
      FROM customers c
     WHERE c.tenant_id = %(tenant_id)s
),
agg AS (
    SELECT o.customer_id,
           sum(o.total_cents)  AS revenue,
           count(*)            AS order_count,
           max(o.created_at)   AS last_order_at
      FROM orders o
     WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'processing', 'shipped', 'delivered')
       AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT id FROM tenant_customers)
     GROUP BY o.customer_id
    HAVING max(o.created_at) >= %(from)s
       AND max(o.created_at) <  %(to)s
)
SELECT c.id,
       c.email,
       c.company,
       c.country_code,
       t.revenue,
       t.order_count,
       t.last_order_at
  FROM tenant_customers c
  JOIN agg t ON t.customer_id = c.id
 ORDER BY t.revenue DESC
 LIMIT %(limit)s
```

De MATERIALIZED-CTE over alle orders van alle tenants en de aparte DISTINCT ON-sortering verdwijnen. Er is nu één aggregatie (sum/count/max) in één scan, die via een semi-join al vooraf beperkt wordt tot klanten van de gevraagde tenant. Omdat `created_at` NOT NULL is, is `max(created_at)` gelijk aan de nieuwste order uit de DISTINCT ON, en het venster-filter kan als HAVING al vóór de join worden toegepast.
